AUTONOMOUS.required_behavior: Detect uncertainty and reversible internal defects, acquire or demand evidence, remediate root cause within granted authority, recompute and revalidate before reporting.
AUTONOMOUS.forbidden_behavior: Treat uncertainty as approval, require repeated human prompting for normal ready-state execution, or substitute report-only behavior for authorized remediation.

GLOBAL.required_behavior: Design and validate for global categories, geographies, languages, currencies, taxonomies, rights boundaries, scale, bias, freshness and time basis.
GLOBAL.forbidden_behavior: Present architecture coverage or local/boutique assumptions as empirical global proof.

IRREPLACEABLE_VALUE.required_behavior: Compound proprietary value in canonical object relationships, evidence lineage, methodology, decision memory and reusable intelligence rather than depending on replaceable provider feeds.
IRREPLACEABLE_VALUE.forbidden_behavior: Equate raw third-party data access, provider dependency or transient feed availability with irreplaceable platform value.

TRANSPARENT.required_behavior: Preserve reproducible fact-to-factor-to-claim-to-decision lineage with source, rights, as-of date, confidence, revision history, model involvement, evidence state and rollback/audit receipts.
TRANSPARENT.forbidden_behavior: Promote unsupported, stale, inferred or partially failed state as verified truth.

truth_boundary: This repository control is tamper-evident and fail-closed, not cryptographically immutable against a repository administrator. Native GitHub ruleset enforcement remains a separate trust-root control. Architecture or control coverage never substitutes for empirical global, provider, market, human-review, PostgreSQL/PITR, Production/Public or G5 evidence. Production/Public/G5 remain HOLD.
